description.name: PenguinPanel Hyper-V
description.tagline: Provision Hyper-V VPS services through the PenguinPanel WHMCS API
description.long: A WHMCS provisioning module for PenguinPanel. WHMCS communicates only with PenguinPanel's authenticated HTTPS provisioning API and never receives direct Hyper-V or PowerShell access.
features: Automatic RDP and internal IPv4 allocation
Optional FiveM TCP and UDP mappings
Live VPS status in the client and admin areas
Dynamic OS template and storage-root loading with live free-space data
Per-service pre-provision storage selection and automatic safest-drive placement
Privacy-safe, recognizable panel usernames based on the WHMCS client first name
Paid VPS resource upgrades/downgrades through WHMCS ChangePackage
